channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Por que um candidato com mais votos pode não se eleger deputado
item.description: In Brazil's proportional system for federal deputies, election depends on both individual votes and the party or federation's total performance. A candidate can receive more votes than another and still not be elected if their group fails to reach the electoral quotient needed to secure sufficient seats. This occurred in 2022 with Rosa Neide (PT) in Mato Grosso and José Serra (PSDB) in São Paulo, while candidates with fewer individual votes, like Tiririca (PL), were elected due to their parties' strong overall performance.

item.title: Entrevista: Lula 'demorou demais' a decidir sobre posição do PT no Rio Grande do Sul, reclama ex-governador Tarso Genro
item.description: Former governor Tarso Genro criticized President Lula for taking too long to define the PT's position in Rio Grande do Sul after the withdrawal of Edegar Pretto's pre-candidacy, stating that the national leadership pushed for support of Juliana Brizola to strengthen Lula's re-election bid, despite viewing the decision as a political loss locally. He denied that intervention occurred in the state party directory, emphasizing that the guidance aimed at unity around Lula's re-election, and argued that Edegar would have been a strong candidate due to his 2022 electoral performance and social articulation.

item.title: Deputados da Alerj reagem à fala de Gilmar Mendes sobre 'mesada do jogo do bicho': 'Grande desconforto'
item.description: STF Minister Gilmar Mendes stated that 32 or 34 deputies of the Alerj received a 'mesada' from the illegal gambling game 'jogo do bicho' based on information from the PF director-general, sparking strong backlash in the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly. Deputies called the accusation grave and unfounded, causing significant discomfort amid institutional fragility, as the Alerj denies any illicit ties and demands evidence for such claims.

item.title: Flávio defende que indígenas criem gado e diz que PT persegue agro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) advocated for indigenous autonomy to raise cattle and exploit their lands, criticized the PT for persecuting agribusiness, and supported the temporal landmark. He also attacked the MST and Minister Marina Silva, claiming the Lula government hates private property.

item.title: Após quatro votos por eleições indiretas, STF suspendeu julgamento sobre sucessão no Rio; entenda situação no estado
item.description: The STF suspended the trial on the method of electing the governor of Rio de Janeiro after four votes favored indirect election (by state deputies) and one vote supported direct election. Minister Flávio Dino requested more time to await the TSE’s joint decision on the ineligibility of Governor Cláudio Castro. In the meantime, the president of the TJ-RJ, Ricardo Couto, serves as interim governor.

item.title: Endividamento dos brasileiros avança e entra na agenda dos pré-candidatos na eleição de 2026
item.description: Brazilian household debt reached a record 80.4% in March, mobilizing the government and entering the agenda for the 2026 presidential election. President Lula and new Finance Minister Dario Durigan are studying a debt refinancing plan with lower interest rates and discounts of up to 80%, while opposition candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado are leveraging the issue to criticize the government.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Azambuja tem vaga ao Senado pelo PL, mesmo com aval de Bolsonaro a Pollon em MS
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Reinaldo Azambuja has one of the PL’s Senate slots in Mato Grosso do Sul, with the other to be decided by future polling, despite Jair Bolsonaro’s prior endorsement of Marcos Pollon. He also praised Tereza Cristina as a 'dream come true' for the vice-presidential slot, highlighting her stature in agribusiness and personal respect for her.

item.title: Em evento em SP, presidente do PT diz que 'claro' que 'Lula é candidato', e Kassab afirma que apoio a Tarcísio 'está decidido'
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva stated that Lula is clearly a candidate for re-election in 2026, emphasizing his readiness to lead Brazil amid international turbulence. He downplayed the Senate race in São Paulo between Marina Silva and Márcio França, saying Simone Tebet will secure the first spot and Haddad will lead the dialogue. PSD leader Gilberto Kassab confirmed the party’s support for Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election in São Paulo, despite a cordial Easter message exchange with Haddad.

item.title: PSD não está atrás de alianças, diz Kassab
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab stated the party is not actively seeking alliances for the 2026 presidential election, prioritizing the consolidation of pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado's government project. He emphasized openness to future talks but stressed the current focus is on building governance capacity, not just winning votes. Kassab also noted that social media have diminished the relevance of traditional coalitions and TV airtime.

item.title: Edinho Silva critica prisões para delação: “Não é correto”
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva criticized the use of imprisonment to pressure individuals into plea bargains, calling the practice 'not correct' and advocating for a review of the model in Brazil. He stated that plea bargaining is a legitimate legal instrument but must not be distorted by coercion, and called for institutional debate on legislative reform. He also defended broader electoral, political, and judicial reforms, asserting that Brazil's political model 'is failing'.

item.title: Kassab descarta apoiar Haddad contra Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, ruled out supporting Fernando Haddad (PT) against Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) in the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race. The PSD has already committed to endorsing Tarcísio's re-election, despite Kassab having served as a government secretary until March 2026. Haddad revealed he exchanged messages with Kassab, questioning the rationale behind continued support for the current governor.

item.title: Kassab descarta aliança com Fernando Haddad, em São Paulo, e diz que apoio a Tarcísio está decidido
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, ruled out an alliance with Fernando Haddad for the São Paulo gubernatorial race, stating that support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas is already decided within the party. He acknowledged exchanging Easter messages with Haddad and being open to discussing public policies, but stressed the PSD is focused on establishing societal commitments, not party alliances at this time. Kassab also denied talks about Ronaldo Caiado’s presidential ticket and said Caiado’s running mate will be defined only in July.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Tereza Cristina de 'sonho de consumo' ao ser questionado sobre vaga de vice em chapa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised Senator Tereza Cristina as a 'dream come true' and affectionately called her 'little grandma', suggesting her as a potential vice-presidential pick for 2026. He highlighted her role as agriculture minister in his father's government and her influence in the agribusiness sector. The remarks were made at Expogrande in Mato Grosso do Sul, amid internal divisions among allies over the vice-presidential choice, with the Centrão backing Tereza Cristina and Bolsonaro's inner circle favoring alternatives like Romeu Zema.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que disputa entre Marina e França por candidatura ao Senado em SP será decidida por Haddad
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, stated that the dispute between Marina Silva (Rede) and Márcio França (PSB) for the Senate seat in São Paulo will be resolved through dialogue, with Fernando Haddad (PT) acting as mediator. He emphasized that both figures will remain part of the progressive political project regardless of who wins the nomination, reinforcing support for Lula's re-election in the state. The remarks were made at an event hosted by the Esfera Brasil group, attended by Gilberto Kassab (PSD).

item.title: TSE condena deputado de Roraima por compra de votos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld the conviction of Roraima state deputy Renan Bekel (Republicanos) for vote buying in the 2018 election. The Court unanimously denied Bekel's appeal, confirming he benefited from a scheme that paid R$250 to electoral 'leaders' and R$100 to voters for committing their vote, backed by evidence including phone intercepts and messages. Relator Minister Villas Bôas Cueva emphasized the robustness of the proof, which includes voter lists and simulated intention-to-vote polls used to trigger payments.

item.title: STF rejeita pedido de Lindbergh para investigar Moro por questionar eleição de Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes rejected requests by federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) to include Senator Sérgio Moro (PL-PR) in an investigation, accepting the PGR's opinion that the deputy lacked active standing to file a crime report. Lindbergh had claimed Moro publicly questioned the legitimacy of Lula's 2022 election victory, but the STF ruled that only the Public Prosecutor's Office can initiate criminal proceedings and that internal regulations prevent direct processing of crime reports by the court.

item.title: Governo recorre de liminar que suspendeu imposto de 12% sobre petróleo
item.description: The federal government appealed to the TRF-2 against an injunction that suspended the collection of a 12% tax on crude oil exports from five multinationals (Shell, Equinor, Petrogal, TotalEnergies and Repsol Sinopec), established by MP 1.340/2026. The first-instance ruling deemed the tax revenue-raising and thus potentially unconstitutional, based on a passage cited by the judge that the government claims does not exist in the Official Gazette. The appeal argues the MP is extrafiscal in nature and that the judicial decision relied on a non-existent legal text.

item.title: STF tem 4×1 por eleição indireta com voto secreto no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) formed a 4×1 majority to elect the new governor of Rio de Janeiro through an indirect election with secret voting in the State Legislative Assembly, following the rapporteur Minister Luiz Fux. The decision came after the resignation of Cláudio Castro (PL), who became ineligible until 2030 due to a TSE conviction for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The judgment was suspended by a request for vista from Minister Flávio Dino, with votes still pending from Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, Gilmar Mendes, and Court President Edson Fachin.

item.title: 'Nosso governador até dezembro', diz alfaiate de Ricardo Couto ao posar com o titular interino do Palácio Guanabara
item.description: Tailor Marcelo Dias of Otto Alfaiataria posted a photo with Rio de Janeiro's acting governor, Justice Ricardo Couto, stating he will be 'governor until December'. Couto took office after Cláudio Castro's resignation and is expected to serve until the STF rules on whether the supplementary election will be direct or indirect, currently leaning 4-1 for indirect but stalled by a view request from Minister Flávio Dino. The post also notes notable clients like Eduardo Paes and Bebeto, both from the PSD party.

item.title: Leite pede desculpa a Caiado por não dar parabéns por pré-candidatura
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite (RS) apologized to Ronaldo Caiado (GO) for not congratulating him on his PSD presidential pre-candidacy after losing the party’s internal dispute. In a meeting and public letter, Leite respected Caiado’s trajectory but reiterated his disagreement with the proposal to grant amnesty to those involved in the January 8 attacks, advocating institutional avenues like refining sentencing. He also outlined five commitments for a centrist project: respect for institutions, fiscal responsibility, equal opportunity, integrity in governance, and dialogue without conflict.

item.title: Petrobras devolverá diferença de preço de leilão de gás
item.description: Petrobras will refund customers the difference between the Import Parity Price (PPI) and the winning bids in the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) auction held on March 31, when prices reached up to double the official table rate. The move follows political pressure, including statements from President Lula, ANP audits, and the dismissal of Claudio Romeo Schlosser, the executive responsible for the auction.

item.title: Valdemar vai aos EUA para apaziguar relação entre Eduardo e Nikolas
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, will travel to the U.S. from April 19 to 22, 2026, to meet with Eduardo Bolsonaro and ease tensions between him and Nikolas Ferreira following a social media clash involving mockery and accusations of disrespect. The move is part of a broader party effort to maintain internal cohesion ahead of the 2026 electoral campaign, avoiding public disputes that could damage the right-wing image. Flávio Bolsonaro also publicly urged rationality and unity among right-wing leaders.

item.title: TSE mantém cassação de deputado de Roraima condenado por compra de votos em 2018
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld the removal of state deputy Renan Bekel (Republicanos-RR) and a fine of R$ 53,000 for vote buying in the 2018 elections. The decision was unanimous, with the rapporteur emphasizing a hierarchical scheme of illicit suffrage capture, featuring fixed payments per vote and internal audits of disbursements. The defense claimed weak evidence and lack of direct candidate involvement, but the TSE plenary rejected both arguments.

item.title: PT deve apoiar o pai de Motta na disputa pelo Senado na Paraíba
item.description: The PT directory in Paraíba is moving to endorse the Senate ticket led by Governor Lucas Ribeiro (PP), which includes former Patos mayor Nabor Wanderley (Republicans), father of Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta. The agreement, reached in a meeting with the national PT leadership in Brasília, includes demands for a vice-presidential candidate slot and a programmatic commitment letter. This comes amid Lula’s struggles to consolidate allied slates in the Northeast, where Ribeiro and Cícero Lucena (MDB) are competing for PT backing.

item.title: Eleições 2026: acesso ao Autoatendimento Eleitoral está mais fácil e rápido
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched a redesigned version of the Electoral Self-Service Portal – Título Net, making access to digital electoral services faster, more intuitive, and requiring fewer clicks. The update improves navigation, organization, and search functionality, particularly for changing electoral residence and updating voter registration data, while preserving all existing features and accessibility resources. The system continues to allow voters to resolve pendencies and issue documents remotely, provided they have collected biometrics or are residing abroad.

item.title: PL projeta eleger 115 deputados em 2026 e quebrar recorde do PFL
item.description: The PL party projects electing 115 federal deputies in 2026, surpassing the PFL's 1998 record of 105 deputies and solidifying its position as the largest caucus in Congress. The estimate, made by party president Valdemar Costa Neto, is based on the current 95 deputies after the party-switching window and anticipates a significant increase in public funding, potentially reaching R$ 260 million annually.

item.title: Lula viaja para a Europa com Mercosul-UE e big techs na pauta
item.description: Lula travels to Europe from April 17–20 to strengthen Brazil’s foreign policy, focusing on accelerating the Mercosul-EU agreement, regulating big techs, and promoting Brazilian industry at Hannover’s industrial fair. The trip includes meetings with leaders from Spain, Portugal, and Germany, plus participation in the 'In Defense of Democracy, Combating Extremism' forum. The goal is to position Brazil as a global leader in digital sovereignty, biofuels, and decarbonization, using foreign policy as an electoral asset for 2026.

item.title: Governo Lula vai autorizar novos saques do FGTS e prevê liberar ao menos R$ 7 bi
item.description: The Lula government is preparing two mechanisms to release extra FGTS funds, aiming to reduce workers' debt in an election year. The plan forecasts releasing at least R$ 7 billion through these measures.

item.title: Michelle elogia Nikolas após Alcolumbre marcar sessão para votar veto de Lula ao PL da redução de penas
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro praised Deputy Nikolas Ferreira after Senate President Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a session to vote on overturning President Lula's veto of a bill reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, a proposal that benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Preocupação de Lula não é com Moraes, é com Lula
item.description: Columnist Carlos Andreazza argues that Lula's concern in commenting on the Master case with Alexandre de Moraes is not to protect the minister, but to avoid associations between his government and the STF that could harm his 2026 re-election bid. He claims that scandals like Banco Master trigger anti-corruption and anti-system sentiments, which have historically hindered Lula’s governance. Lula’s remarks are seen as a symbolic distancing tactic to mitigate electoral damage.

item.title: O RS é um case de como Lula sacrifica o PT em nome do ‘projeto maior’: ele
item.description: Lula is sacrificing the PT in Rio Grande do Sul by imposing Juliana Brizola (PDT) as the gubernatorial candidate, following a pattern of blocking new left-wing leaders and prioritizing his own political project. This strategy, already seen in RJ, MG, PE, and MA, weakens the PT and leaves the party dependent on allies, undermining the strength of the left as a whole. In RS, the PT has not had its own candidate since 1982, and top-down pressure — including threats of intervention — reveals a logic of control that shifts electoral risks onto figures like Fernando Haddad in SP, making him hostage to Lula’s performance.

item.title: Leite indica apoio a Caiado, mas critica promessa de anistia ao 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Eduardo Leite, governor of Rio Grande do Sul (PSD), expressed support for Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), the party's pre-candidate for president in 2026, following a meeting and the delivery of an open letter outlining conditions for alliance. Despite being passed over by the PSD for the presidential nomination, Leite stated he is ready to assist Caiado in building a viable alternative to polarization, provided there are concrete gestures toward institutional respect, fiscal responsibility, effective social policies, and moderate dialogue. Leite specifically criticized Caiado’s proposal for broad amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks, arguing it would hinder national pacification and disrupt dialogue with a significant portion of the population.

item.title: Caiado confirma carta de Eduardo Leite e destaca convergência no PSD
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) confirmed receiving a letter from Rio Grande do Sul governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) containing relevant topics for the 2026 presidential campaign. He emphasized that there was convergence on the discussed points and that areas of agreement prevailed between the two PSD leaders.

item.title: Entenda o placar parcial no STF sobre a eleição para governador do Rio
item.description: The STF resumed the trial on the election model for Rio de Janeiro governor after Claudio Castro's resignation. The partial count stands at 4 votes in favor of indirect election and 1 for direct election, with Flávio Dino having requested vista and awaiting the TSE's acórdão publication. Cristiano Zanin is the only justice so far advocating for a direct election.

item.title: PT fica sem candidato ao governo do Rio Grande do Sul pela primeira vez, após pressão de Lula
item.description: For the first time in its history, the PT has decided not to run its own candidate for governor of Rio Grande do Sul, yielding to pressure from President Lula, and will now support Juliana Brizola (PDT) as the main candidate, with Edegar Pretto (PT) likely as her running mate. The move has caused friction with PSOL, which backed Pretto and threatens to leave the coalition. The opposition front, comprising PDT, PT, PSB, PSOL, PCdoB, PV and Rede, aims to strengthen the slate to boost Lula’s 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: Kassab aposta em Caiado e vê Eduardo Paes como trunfo no Rio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, supports Ronaldo Caiado's presidential bid in 2026, believing there is room for growth among voters rejecting traditional political poles. He highlights Rio de Janeiro as a key state, with Eduardo Paes as a strong potential gubernatorial candidate due to the capital's electoral weight and his social media presence. Kassab refrains from confirming Paes's candidacy, stating the decision is his, but notes Paes has the party's delegation.

item.title: A crítica de Leite ao plano de Caiado para anistiar golpistas
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) apologized to Ronaldo Caiado for not congratulating him after the PSD nominated him for president, but reiterated his disagreement with Caiado's plan to grant broad, general, and unrestricted amnesty to those involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks, arguing it would disrupt dialogue with a significant portion of the population.

item.title: Leite pede desculpas a Caiado, mas critica ideia de anistia a presos no 8/1
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite publicly apologized to PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado for not congratulating him after being chosen by the party for the 2026 race. However, Leite disagreed with the PSD's decision to nominate Caiado. He also criticized the idea of granting amnesty to those involved in the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Eduardo Leite pede desculpas a Caiado por não parabenizá-lo pelo anúncio de pré-candidatura e anuncia reaproximação
item.description: Eduardo Leite, governor of Rio Grande do Sul (PSD), apologized for not congratulating Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) on his PSD presidential pre-candidacy nomination, stating his support will depend on Caiado’s campaign platform. Leite maintained his disagreement with the party’s scenario reading but affirmed Caiado’s reputation, delivering a letter with key issues for the campaign. Caiado, named as the PSD’s pre-candidate after Ratinho Júnior’s withdrawal, is focusing his pre-campaign in São Paulo, emphasizing public safety and economic outreach.

item.title: Pressa para votar dosimetria passa por acordo sobre não instalar CPMI do Master, avaliam governistas
item.description: Government allies assess that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's urgency to schedule the vote overturning vetoes on the dosimetry bill is tied to an agreement with the opposition to avoid installing the Banco Master CPMI. The bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, was fully vetoed by Lula. While Alcolumbre's allies claim the April 30 session will focus solely on the vetoes, his interlocutors deny any formal agreement with the opposition.

item.title: Messias comemora data de sabatina no Senado para o STF
item.description: Union General Counsel Jorge Messias celebrated the announcement of his Senate confirmation hearing for April 29 as part of his nomination to the Supreme Court by President Lula. He thanked Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, CCJ President Otto Alencar, and rapporteur Weverton Rocha, reaffirming his commitment to respectful dialogue with senators. According to a Poder360 survey, Messias has 25 declared supporters, needs 16 more to reach the 41 votes required, and already has 10 of the 14 votes needed in the CCJ.

item.title: Câmara rejeita mudança do Senado na MP do Seguro-Defeso
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies rejected Senate amendments to the MP on Seguro-Defeso, restoring the version previously approved by the Chamber. The text now proceeds to presidential sanction by Lula and establishes new registration and identification requirements for fishermen to prevent fraud in benefit payments, while also allowing the settlement of pending 2026 installments. The Seguro-Defeso is a social benefit paid to fishers during the fishing ban for fish reproduction, and its expenses will be excluded from the budget limit under Law 10.779/03.

item.title: Lula tentou se afastar da crise do STF
item.description: Lula sought to distance himself from the STF crisis involving ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli, publicly commenting on the impropriety of their participation in the Master case judgment due to their commercial ties with the bank involved. Although he used a personal tone by calling Moraes a 'companheiro,' his statement was interpreted as an effort to avoid associating the government with the controversy, given that while the STF is a political ally, it suffers from negative public opinion that reflects on the administration. The article suggests Lula recognizes the crisis’s negative impact on his government and is attempting to preserve his image by not openly endorsing the ministers’ actions.

item.title: Gotham City é pinto diante do descalabro do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: A lawyer compared the crisis in Rio de Janeiro to Gotham City, stating that if the election were indirect, it would be easier to elect the Joker than Batman. The remark was made in the Federal Supreme Court during an exclusive subscriber-only article, emphasizing the institutional and security chaos in the city.

item.title: Indicado ao STF, Messias reage à definição de sabatina no Senado
item.description: Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union and Lula's nominee for the Supreme Federal Court (STF), expressed optimism and serenity upon learning that his Senate confirmation hearing will take place on April 29. He thanked Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, CCJ President Otto Alencar, and rapporteur Weverton Rocha, pledging to maintain open and respectful dialogue with all 81 senators before the hearing. Senator Weverton Rocha, the rapporteur, stated his report will be favorable, citing Messias' legal expertise, impeccable reputation, and distinguished career.

item.title: Haddad abre conversas com liderança do agro para disputa em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad confirmed he spoke with Teresa Vendramini, former president of the Brazilian Rural Society, and encouraged her to enter public life. He mentioned her nickname 'Teca' as a potential running mate for the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race, alongside Márcio França and Marina. The move aims to strengthen agribusiness support for the PT candidacy.

item.title: Vídeo: Sabatina de Jorge Messias é marcada para 29 de abril
item.description: The sabatina (hearing) for Jorge Messias, nominated by President Lula to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), is scheduled for April 29 in the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), with a plenary vote expected the same day. Senator Weverton (PDT-MA) is the rapporteur of the nomination. Although announced in 2025, the name was formally submitted to the Senate only last week.

item.title: Seguro-defeso: Câmara rejeita mudança feita pelo Senado e texto vai à sanção
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies rejected the Senate's amendments to Bill PLV 1/2026, preserving the original text by Senator Beto Faro (PT-PA) on the fisheries unemployment insurance (seguro-defeso). The bill, headed for presidential sanction, sets new registration and identification rules to prevent fraud, allows settlement of pending installments in 2026 if eligibility criteria are met, and excludes arrears payments from the budget ceiling under Law 10.779/03. For 2026, the total allocated for seguro-defeso, excluding arrears, is R$ 7.9 billion.

item.title: STF tem 4 a 1 por eleição indireta no Rio e julgamento é suspenso por pedido de vista
item.description: The Federal Supreme Court formed a 4-1 majority in favor of indirect election for the interim government mandate in Rio de Janeiro, with ministers André Mendonça, Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia supporting the prevailing position. The session was suspended following a request for review by Minister Flávio Dino, halting the judgment before its conclusion.

item.title: O lado do juiz
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça received a high honor from the São Paulo Legislative Assembly for his work in investigations involving the defunct Banco Master and improper deductions from retirees' payments. He is viewed as a hope by the opposition to President Lula, despite claiming that money should not be the goal in legal careers. Mendonça is expanding his educational business through the Iter institute, raising concerns about potential conflicts of interest.
